[42823 Applied Data Analytics | Subject description]
Credit points: 2

Applied Data Analytics sharpens your ability to independently plan and execute a data mining project, utilising the widely-adopted CRISP-DM methodology. From preprocessing to deploying results, you'll engage with various representation techniques and apply your analytics expertise to real industry scenarios, effectively communicating your findings. This practical, problem-based microcredential is focused on developing both your analytical autonomy and professional articulation.

[42823 Applied Data Analytics | Learning and teaching activities]
Microcredential presentation includes weekly synchronous one-hour online workshops facilitated by an expert UTS academic(s) supporting self-study and online (LMS) learning activities. Case studies of real-world business illustrate applications of data mining techniques. The workshop sessions focus on hands-on experience in data mining and data analytics tools, and the understanding and interpretation of the results. Regular formative quizzes throughout the semester will allow learners to gauge their progress.
